title: crataegus oxyacantha f. punicea
intro: Crataegus oxyacantha f. punicea, commonly known as Purple Hawthorn, is a deciduous shrub or small tree that belongs to the Rosaceae family. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to support cardiovascular health, with potential benefits including lowering blood pressure, reducing cholesterol levels, and improving overall heart function. The therapeutic actions of Purple Hawthorn are attributed to its ability to act as a vasodilator, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant, which helps to protect the heart and blood vessels from damage. The bioactive constituents of Purple Hawthorn include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and oligomeric proanthocyanidins, which contribute to its potential health benefits.
